title: Crispy Chicken Cutlets Marinara
seoTitle: Crispy Chicken Cutlets Marinara | Firefighter Meal
subtitle: Golden cutlets, bubbling sauce
description: Golden cutlets, bubbling sauce. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.

steps.title: Bread the cutlets
steps.instruction: Season cutlets with salt. Dredge flour → egg → panko, pressing crumbs to adhere. Rest breaded cutlets on a rack 10 minutes so coating sets.

steps.title: Fry until golden
steps.instruction: Fry in 350°F oil in batches 3–4 minutes per side until deep golden and 165°F inside. Drain on a rack, not paper-only — steam softens crust.

steps.title: Simmer marinara
steps.instruction: Warm marinara in a wide skillet over medium heat. Season with a pinch of salt and basil if you have it — sauce should bubble gently, not spit.

steps.title: Melt cheese and serve
steps.instruction: Nestle cutlets in sauce, top with mozzarella, cover 2–3 minutes until cheese melts. Finish with Parmesan. Serve from the skillet or transfer to sheet trays at 200°F for late eaters.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
Pull chicken at 160°F and let carryover hit 165°F — dry breast ruins crew morale.
tonightSpread: Plate Crispy Chicken Cutlets Marinara with sides in separate pans so the crew can mix portions.
Line up Crispy Chicken Cutlets Marinara on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Golden cutlets, bubbling sauce. A hall pick for regular dinner nights — one line, real portions, no drama at the stove.
substitutions: Chicken thighs ↔ breasts (thighs forgive overcooking on the flat-top).

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a 1:1 gluten-free all-purpose flour blend. Use certified gluten-free panko/breadcrumbs, or crushed gluten-free crackers.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative.
